notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it. Issue wording is the notice's summary; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.

issues.title: Amendment to Sections 161.01, 161.03(A) and 162.013(A) of the Codified Ordinances: sidewalks in the 0.25% income tax allocation
issues.area: Medina City wards 1–4, plus splits 080/2-LFTD and 118/2-YKTA
issues.text: An amendment to Sections 161.01, 161.03(A), and 162.013(A) of the Codified Ordinances of the City of Medina to include the installation, maintenance, repair and/or replacement of sidewalks as a permitted expense within the 0.25% income tax allocation that is currently restricted for improvements for streets, storm water, and utility improvements?

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #1: Section 9.05
issues.text: Eliminate outdated language regarding the civil service status of employees and add a new section allowing for the removal of a member of City Council by other members of City Council for bad behavior, criminal conduct, or absenteeism.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #2: Articles III, IV, VII, XII and XIII
issues.text: Change the date of the organizational meeting, change the date that elected officials take office, and change the deadline that nominating petitions for elective offices in the municipality must be submitted to the Board of Elections.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #3: Section 3.06
issues.text: Allow City Council to hold executive sessions for any reason allowable by Ohio Revised Code.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #4: Section 4.03
issues.text: Clarify language that the Mayor, when invited, is only an attendee and does not preside over executive sessions of City Council.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #5: Section 4.05
issues.text: Clarify the procedure by which a member of City Council is nominated to and can become Mayor in the event the office of Mayor becomes vacant.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #6: Section 5.01
issues.text: Require an annual review of the Municipal Manager by City Council.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #7: Articles VI and IX
issues.text: Change language to reflect that the Fire and EMS departments have merged into one department.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #8: Section 6.05
issues.text: Require that the Law Director be an attorney-in-fact in good standing with the State Bar Association and oversee representation of the City in all cases as well as provide direct representation.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #9: Section 9.01
issues.text: Update old language concerning the establishment of a Civil Service Commission if Rittman became a city, as Rittman is already a city.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #10: Section 9.02
issues.text: Change the term an individual serves on the Civil Service Commission from six (6) years to three (3) years.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #11: Section 11.01
issues.text: Add a member of City Council to serve on the Cemetery Board.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #12: Section 12.02
issues.text: Change the deadline for submitting the budget to City Council from January 1st to December 31st and clarify language.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #13: Section 12.06
issues.text: Require an annual review of the Finance Director by City Council.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #14: Section 13.04
issues.text: Reduce the residency requirement to be eligible to be an elected officer of the municipality from two (2) years to one (1) year.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #15: Section 16.01
issues.text: Amend the schedule in which the Charter Review Commission convenes to intentionally misalign it with the election of new members of City Council.
